about: Every skip a gate accepts. A skipped test that matches no entry refuses the gate, so a required case cannot be waived by relabelling it skipped. An entry with `gates` applies only to the gates it names: the opt-in benchmarks may be skipped for a Development Gate. A Release Gate runs each benchmark file alone in its own pass (benchmarks.mjs) and accepts the main run's skip only for a test that passed there. Each entry names why the skip is correct and where the behaviour is otherwise covered; review the list at every release candidate.

skips.title: /^stock command timings on a loaded ledger > /
skips.reason: Opt-in benchmark (FV_BENCHMARK=1). Measures timings; stock correctness is covered by stock-invariant and inventory. Every Release Gate runs it.
skips.review: At every release candidate, which runs it.

skips.title: /^stock commands on a phone over 4G > /
skips.reason: Opt-in benchmark (FV_BENCHMARK=1). Stock journeys are covered by inventory, production and stock-invariant on all three tiers. Every Release Gate runs it.
skips.review: At every release candidate, which runs it.

skips.title: /^stock commands on a phone over 4G > /
skips.reason: Measured on the mobile profile only, by design; with benchmarks on, the mobile run is required.
skips.review: Permanent: the benchmark defines a phone over 4G.

skips.title: /mobile benchmark > /
skips.reason: Opt-in benchmarks (FV_BENCHMARK=1). The journeys they time run unskipped in the same files on all three tiers. Every Release Gate runs them.
skips.review: At every release candidate, which runs them.

skips.title: /mobile benchmark > /
skips.reason: Measured on the mobile profile only, by design; with benchmarks on, the mobile run is required.
skips.review: Permanent: the benchmarks define a phone profile.

skips.title: the rail or sidebar sits beside the page, not above it
skips.reason: The phone has a drawer, not a rail; the drawer is tested on mobile in the same file.
skips.review: Permanent: the layout differs by design (design.md §3).

skips.title: touch targets on the sign-in form meet the 44px floor
skips.reason: The 44px floor applies to touch tiers only (design.md §9.9).

skips.title: /every control a thumb reaches is at least 44 pixels tall on a touch tier$/
skips.reason: The 44px floor applies to touch tiers only (design.md §9.9); desktop controls are 40px and 32px by design.

skips.title: /^the three-step order on a phone > /
skips.reason: The three-step order exists only below the md breakpoint; tablet and desktop order entry is covered elsewhere in the same file.
skips.review: Permanent: the layout differs by design.
